AI-Agent customer support software that auto-resolves tickets, assists agents, and scales with your team. Try SparrowDesk free.
You run support. AI runs the busywork.
Zoona answers the repeat questions on email, chat and tickets. Your team takes the conversations that need a person.
No credit card · 14-day trial · Live in a day
Trusted by 1,000+ support teams
Meet Zoona the AI agent that handles the busywork.
Zoona reads every ticket, works out what the customer needs, and answers on its own — day or night. Your team steps in only when a human's needed.
Train it in minutes, not months
Zoona learns from what you already have — your website, help center, Notion, docs, even past conversations. Point it at your sources and it starts answering. You don't write a thing.
Zoona resolves it, start to finish.
Zoona reads the ticket, understands the intent, and sends the right response instantly. Your customers get answers at 2am on a Sunday without anyone on your team lifting a finger.
Every channel. Every language. One AI agent
Email, live chat, WhatsApp, Slack - Zoona works across all of them. It responds in the language your customer writes in, so language is never a barrier to great support.
Gets smarter every single day
Zoona flags tickets it can not answer and updates its own knowledge base automatically. Your support gets smarter over time, no maintenance required.
Works with the tools you already run on
I never imagined setting up customer support could be this easy. Setting up email, live chat, and our help center was a breeze with SparrowDesk. We use the Slack integration to run support right from Slack, and with Zoona handling more than 67% of conversations, our small team can keep up as customer support grows.

The helpdesk your agents will actually want to use
Reporting you can actually read.
Build the reports your team needs, or just ask Copilot — “how many tickets are SLA-due this week?” — and get the answer from live data. No dashboards to wrestle, no analyst required.
CSAT that closes the loop.
A one-tap survey goes out the moment you close a ticket, so the score comes straight from the customer. Catch the reply that missed while there’s still time to fix it.
Your help center answers first.
Turn your knowledge base into a branded, searchable help center — the same docs that train Zoona. Customers find answers themselves, so fewer tickets ever reach your team.
Multilingual support, built in.
Customers write in whatever language they think in, and SparrowDesk translates the thread both ways. Your team answers in a click — no specialist to hire.
Set the SLA. Never watch the clock.
Give every ticket a response and resolution target, and SparrowDesk tracks it — nudging your team before one breaches. Everyone sees what’s due, not what’s already late.
Your customer data is safe.
SparrowDesk is SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant. Your data is never used to train AI models. What your customers share with you stays with you
Your support team deserves this. Start today.
Set up SparrowDesk in minutes, not months. No credit card needed, no safe call required. Just a better way to run support from day one.

CSAT

Track customer satisfaction the moment an interaction is complete. Simple, native feedback across channels.
Trusted by 1,000+ support teams
Collect feedback at the right moment
Send CSAT surveys automatically after a support interaction is completed. Feedback is collected when it makes sense, without manual effort.
Customize how it works for your team
Choose your rating scale and tailor the survey experience. Update questions and branding from a dedicated customization page.
See feedback in the inbox
View CSAT ratings directly within each conversation. Customer satisfaction feedback stays tied to the interaction it belongs to.
Track satisfaction with reports
Monitor CSAT scores and customer satisfaction trends across channels and interactions. Clear reporting makes it easier to measure performance over time.
Turn CSAT surveys into clear support signals
Identify gaps and strengths
CSAT scores highlight conversations that need attention and reveal what customers value most. Clear signals show where expectations fall short and where support performs well.
Improve support and processes
Customer satisfaction feedback guides improvements in workflows and recurring issue handling. CSAT insights help raise the overall quality of support.
Build stronger relationships
Responding to CSAT feedback strengthens trust over time. Consistent improvements reduce churn risk and improve overall experience.
